info.title: Zupflow API
info.description: Generated from @zupflow/contract. Every response is an envelope `{ data, meta, error }`; IDs are prefixed, opaque strings.

consoleSession.description: A Console session. Workspace routes also need the `organization` header.

organization.name: Zupflow-Organization
organization.description: The organization a Console call acts in (`org_…`). Required with a Console session on workspace routes; 400 `organization_required` without it.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Makes a retry safe: 1–255 printable ASCII characters, scoped to the caller that sent it, kept for 24 hours. The same key and request replays the saved response; the same key with a different request answers `422 idempotency_key_reused`; a key still in flight answers `409 idempotency_request_in_progress`; a malformed key answers `400 invalid_idempotency_key`. Routes marked `x-zupflow-shows-secret-once` never save their body: a retry answers `409 idempotency_key_completed`.

Error.description: An error: branch on `error.code`, never on `error.message`.
